conditions_of_use: 1 Required runs: saved QA with --carrier = the frozen route carrier (expected_provenance.carrier_sha256 checked against ADAPTER_RECEIPT.json carrier_sha256 or the freeze record, and the check recorded), --writer-dir, without --no-formatting; status SAVED_ALL_CELL_VALUE_TYPE_PASS, expected_provenance.result PASS, receipt_claims.match true, cps_evidence_preconditions.all_checked_here_met true (for a titled output this includes deliverable_checked and deliverable_byte_identical_to_rerun).

2 Checker node: run from a clean shell independent of the producer, with --checker-node and --checker-node-sha256 from this record (checker_node; further binaries need their own entry, for example the Dot VM's node after its full self-test); never taken from the producer receipt, --node or PATH; checker_node.realpath, sha256 and sha256_after_check must match, and the same file must appear in writer004_check_node (v1 receipts) and rerun_node.

3 Tools: before the run the operator checks the sha256 of saved_qa.py, writer_portable.py, writer004_matrices.mjs and visual_qa.py against files_sha256; the saved-QA record must show the listed writer_portable.py and writer004_matrices.mjs hashes.
4 Writer directory and versions: pinned files as regular files in the writer directory; the checker --writer-dir holds the same writer004.mjs pin as the producer; openpyxl 3.1.5.

5 Receipt: only the compared fields count (mode, relaxations without route_v4_port.path, cross_check, expected_saved_values, matrices_sha256, sheets, writer, writer_files, status, admitted, deliverable, deliverable_xlsx); v2 relaxation classes and documented cells come from expected_provenance.rerun_relaxation_classes and rerun_documented_cells. A WRITER_RECEIPT.json with duplicate JSON keys is not evidence (v2.5 open note N1): the run harness rejects it before saved QA.

6 Mode v2 only for carriers whose convert receipt says export_mode_required v2 and policy_checks applied; reported as writer004 on the placeholder copy plus the documented cells; M/N facts are R48 policy checks. Saved QA establishes saved-cell fidelity to writer004 intended matrices (and, for the deliverable, to the main matrix) only: nothing about source semantics or Excel display.
7 Job title: --job-title is the harness's per-job project folder title; the operator checks deliverable.job_title against the per-job input record and records the check.

8 Visual QA: never re-save a workbook. Render the delivered <name>.xlsx and INTERNAL_QA_WORKBOOK.xlsx separately; each manifest's saved_xlsx.sha256 must equal the corresponding hash in the evidence-grade SAVED_QA.json (deliverable_xlsx.sha256 for the delivered workbook, xlsx.sha256 for the internal one). A separate reviewer checks every page of the delivered workbook against the README delivered-workbook checklist, and the internal workbook's reviewed set (every page of the main and composition sheets; review sheet pages 1, 2, the last and every page with a possibly_clipped_cells cell) against the 9-item internal checklist; VISUAL_REVIEW.json per run records page -> item -> pass/fail; any fail fails visual QA. v2.8.2 (O39, F3): the delivered workbook is rendered without --dpi (auto dpi), and the visual reviewer reads every tile of every delivered page listed in the manifest (images[].tiles), checked against their sha256; delivered checklist item 9 includes "no value is cut at a column edge or by a filled neighbour".

9 Delivery (O38; review N3r): deliver only <name>.xlsx. At delivery time, check that the file sent is a regular file whose sha256 equals deliverable_xlsx.sha256 in the run's evidence-grade SAVED_QA.json, and record the check. Never deliver INTERNAL_QA_WORKBOOK.xlsx, EXPECTED_SAVED_VALUES.json, the receipt or QA reports.
10 This record is the admission for the hashes listed; the README status text is superseded by it.
